notes.title: Update 2.00.33 - Tutorial Rework, Balancing Improvements and fixes
notes.content:
Commanders, 

We’ve just released update 2.00.33

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Tutorial Rework
[i]Dev notes: Changes have been made to improve the new player experience. The tutorial functions the same except the pacing of the first mission is much faster. We felt it dragged a little too much, especially during the first few waves. We hope new and returning players enjoy the rework.[/i]
[*]Early game balancing / Pacing improvements
[i]Dev notes: Additionally we have made further improvements to the pacing and balancing of the earlier game. Waves, especially earlier ones will progress quicker and we have boosted the starting credits during some deployments to provide more flexibility and room for experimentation during the first few waves. We hope new and returning players enjoy the rework.[/i]
[*]UI Improvements (Better feedback and responsiveness in some situations)
[*]Artillery turret no longer has to reload when first built. It will fire immediately after construction
[*]Airstrike base damage slightly increased across all damage types
[*]Machine gun turret range increased slightly (all levels)
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[olist]
[*] Players could not build anything if the camera is adjusted during the initial tutorial
[/olist]
As always, thank you for your feedback!

Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.98.31 - Steam Deck Optimisations, Quality of Life and Balancing
notes.content:
Commanders,

We’ve just released update 1.98.31 on PC.

[b]Quality of Life[/b]

[list]
[*]Steam deck optimisations – UI and text now scale correctly, improved controls, updated tutorial
[*]UI Scaling option added to the display settings
[*]Drone rockets are now hold to fire instead of tap to fire
[*]Key binding options have been added for quick selection of the airstrike, command centre rapid repair, and tactical drone
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]

[list]
[*] Tweaks have been made to the balancing of some of the later missions on normal mode to make the experience a little more forgiving
[*]Starting credits on Return to Mars have been increased across all game modes
[*]Other minor balancing tweaks
[/list]
As always thank you for your continued feedback. We hope you enjoy the update.

Good luck Commander and have fun!

notes.title: Patch 1.92 Bug Fixing, Balancing and Quality of Life
notes.content:
Commanders,

We have just released update 1.92 which contains a number of bug fixes, changes and quality of life improvements

[b]ADDED[/b]

- Camera movement tutorial (All languages)

[b]CHANGES[/b]

- Hard cap of 300 FPS to prevent excess GPU usage when vsync is off
- Tactical drone tower damage bonus increased from 30% to 100%
- Cursor size increased

[b]FIXES[/b]

- Mission debrief doesn't always appear when completing an achievement
- Plasma turret level 3 charge visuals

As always, thank you for your continued feedback.

Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Patch 1.91 Balancing Adjustments
notes.content:
Commanders,

We've been closely monitoring feedback and our latest update includes a number of changes to improve the general balance experience across the campaign.

[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] Megaflesh wing boss now approaches the command center from the rear so nearby turrets can engage
[*] The tactical drone now unlocks automatically at experience level 5 without the need for tech points
[/list]
[b]MAPS[/b]
[list]
[*] Starting credits on Neptune increased from 480 to 500 (Normal mode)
[*] Starting credits on Uranus increased from 530 to 540 (Normal mode)
[*] Starting credits on Carrier departure increased from 645 to 665 (Normal mode)
[*] Starting credits on Asteroid Mining increased from 1020 to 1035 (Nightmare mode)
[/list]
[b]TURRETS[/b]
[list]
[*] Gatling gun base / charged attack damage increased a small amount against all armor types
[*] Uranium artillery base / charged attack increased a small amount against weak / tough armor
[*] Napalm charged attack pool duration extended from 8 to 12 seconds 
[*] Machine gun rocket pods now fire an additional 2 rocket volleys when the charged attack is activated
[/list]
[b]AUDIO[/b]
[list]
[*] Gatling gun firing audio reduced
[/list]
Thank you to everyone who reported feedback so far.

Good luck and have fun!
